title: Open minting context
description: Minting contexts with arbitrary transaction information, policy ID, and redeemer. The constructor fixes the script purpose to minting and adds no ledger-validity conditions.

title: Open withdrawal context
description: Reward withdrawal contexts with arbitrary transaction information, credential, and redeemer. The constructor fixes the script purpose to rewarding and adds no ledger-validity conditions.

title: Open certificate context
description: Certifying contexts with arbitrary transaction information, certificate index, certificate, and redeemer. The constructor fixes the script purpose to certifying and adds no ledger-validity conditions.

title: Open voting context
description: Voting contexts with arbitrary transaction information, voter, and redeemer. The constructor fixes the script purpose to voting and adds no ledger-validity conditions.

title: Open proposal context
description: Proposing contexts with arbitrary transaction information, proposal index, proposal procedure, and redeemer. The constructor fixes the script purpose to proposing and adds no ledger-validity conditions.

title: Open spending context
description: Spending contexts with arbitrary transaction information, spent-output reference, optional datum, and redeemer. The constructor fixes the script purpose to spending and adds no ledger-validity conditions.
